title: The Initiative
subtitle: A cooperative strategy campaign of covert infiltration, comic-book mystery, and cipher breaking
tagline: Four teenagers find a mysterious game. Reality is about to blur.
loreSummary: In 1994, four suburban teenagers discover a clandestine board game called 'The Key' at a local yard sale. As they play through tactical room breaches and decipher cryptograms on a secret console, they uncover astonishing parallels between the comic book narrative and dangerous secrets unfolding in the real world.
keyFeatures: Dual-layered narrative linking a 48-page comic book story with evolving board gameplay
Tactical room-to-room infiltration with stealth movement, clue gathering, and timer pressure
Interactive physical secret console simulating real-time cryptographic decipherment
Accessible cooperative mechanics designed by Corey Konieczka with rich campaign puzzle depth
Post-campaign standalone enigma puzzles and secret envelopes extending replayability

the_initiative_campaign.name: Comic Book Campaign (14 Missions)
the_initiative_campaign.description: The complete 14-mission narrative campaign following the four teenagers through the 48-page comic book story, cracking ciphers and uncovering the true nature of The Initiative.

the_initiative_early_chapters.name: Opening Chapters Arc (6 Missions)
the_initiative_early_chapters.description: The first 6 introductory missions establishing core movement tactics, first cipher discoveries, and initial comic book plot revelations.

the_initiative_complete_enigma.name: Complete Campaign & Enigma Mode (24 Missions)
the_initiative_complete_enigma.description: All 14 core campaign missions plus 10 challenging standalone and secret envelope cipher missions for master codebreakers.

milestones.title: The Mysterious Game
milestones.description: Four suburban teenage friends acquire a cryptic vintage game called 'The Key' and decipher their first concealed message on the secret console.

milestones.title: First Cracking of the Code
milestones.description: The team uncovers startling real-world parallels as their cipher console reveals deeper conspiratorial clues embedded throughout the comic book.

milestones.title: Into the Surveillance Net
milestones.description: Infiltrating restricted complex sectors, the teenagers gather critical glyphs while dodging shadowy surveillance operatives closing in.

milestones.title: The Keycard Infiltration

milestones.title: The Final Transmission Deciphered
